title: The Effect of Womb Recordings on Maturation of Respiratory Control in Preterm Infants
official: Womb Recordings and Respiratory Control Maturation in Neonates
summary: The aim of this proposal is to characterize the acute effect of early postnatal sound exposure on neuronal maturation of the respiratory control regions of the brain in preterm infants.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* preterm infants 29-33 weeks gestational age at birth
* 34 weeks corrected age
* off respiratory support \>1.5 lpm

Exclusion Criteria:

* on respiratory support \>1.5 lpm
* congenital anomalies
